roadmap.title: Learn the base game
roadmap.description: Plan at least 67 leader victories and 24 scenario victories, plus partial matches for special setups. Learn the base mechanics first and combine compatible tasks in the same match.

roadmap.title: Base-game leaders and special challenges
roadmap.description: Plan separate leader games and map setups for civilization-specific tasks.

roadmap.title: Civilization packs and scenarios
roadmap.description: Work through the original civilization packs and their scenarios, grouping each scenario’s tasks.

roadmap.title: Rise and Fall
roadmap.description: Use the Rise and Fall ruleset for its leaders, loyalty, governors, ages, and alliance tasks.

roadmap.title: Gathering Storm and free scenarios
roadmap.description: Use Gathering Storm for its expansion tasks, then play the free Red Death and Pirates scenarios.

roadmap.title: New Frontier and Leader Pass
roadmap.description: Enable the required game modes and choose the matching leaders for the remaining packs and free modes.

achievements.description: Win a regular game at Settler difficulty or harder
achievements.summary: Finish a regular game with a victory on Settler or a higher difficulty.

steps.text: Select @mechanic{Settler} difficulty and Standard Rules. Set a custom one-turn limit, found your first city, then end the turn.
If the score ranking gives an opponent the win, use a late-era start and a 3–5-turn limit. Found additional cities and buy tiles to raise your score before the limit.

achievements.description: Win a regular game with a Science victory on any difficulty with any leader
achievements.summary: Achieve a Science Victory in a regular game.

steps.text: Choose Standard Rules and an Information Era start on Settler difficulty. Build a @mechanic{Spaceport} and complete Launch Earth Satellite.
Research Satellites and complete Launch Moon Landing.
Research Nuclear Fusion, Robotics and Nanotechnology. Complete Launch Mars Reactor, Launch Mars Habitation and Launch Mars Hydroponics in cities with Spaceports.

achievements.description: Win a regular game with a Religious victory on any difficulty with any leader
achievements.summary: Achieve a Religious Victory in a regular game.

steps.text: Choose a Duel map on Settler difficulty with Mvemba a Nzinga as your opponent, and leave only Religious Victory enabled.
Found a religion and build Holy Sites to generate Faith. Use Missionaries and Apostles to spread your religion until the religious victory panel shows the required dominance.

achievements.displayName: Buying Your Blue Jeans and Listening to Your Pop Music
achievements.description: Win a regular game with a Culture victory on any difficulty with any leader
achievements.summary: Achieve a Culture Victory in a regular game.

steps.text: Use a Duel map on Settler difficulty with only Culture Victory enabled. Build Theater Squares, recruit Great Writers, Artists and Musicians, and create their Great Works.
Increase Tourism with wonders and policy cards. Keep open borders and trade routes with your opponent, and follow the tourist requirement in the victory panel.

achievements.description: Win a regular game with a Domination victory on any difficulty with any leader
achievements.summary: Achieve a Domination Victory in a regular game.

steps.text: Start a Duel game on Settler difficulty and capture the other civilization’s original capital with your army.

If an opponent wins on score, start in a later era with a 3–5-turn limit. Found more cities and buy tiles before the score is counted.

achievements.description: Receive a Strategic Resource from Hattusa
achievements.summary: Obtain a strategic resource through Hattusa’s suzerain bonus.

steps.text: Find @loc{Hattusa} and send enough Envoys to become its Suzerain. Research a technology that reveals a strategic resource you do not possess, then let Hattusa supply that resource.

achievements.description: Build a Colossal Head adjacent to a Holy Site with a Temple.
achievements.summary: Construct a Colossal Head beside a Holy Site that already contains a Temple.

steps.text: Become Suzerain of @loc{La Venta}. Build a Holy Site and its Temple, then use a Builder to place a @mechanic{Colossal Head} on an adjacent tile.

achievements.description: Levy the military of Nan Madol
achievements.summary: Pay to levy Nan Madol’s military.

steps.text: Become Suzerain of @loc{Nan Madol}, open its city-state panel and choose @mechanic{Levy Military}.

achievements.description: As America make a National Park of Crater Lake and both tiles of Yosemite in one game
achievements.summary: Create National Parks containing Crater Lake and at least one Yosemite tile in one game as America.

steps.text: Start as America on a map containing @loc{Crater Lake} and @loc{Yosemite}. An Information Era start lets you launch a satellite to locate both wonders.
Settle near each wonder and obtain the surrounding tiles. Each park needs four eligible tiles in a vertical diamond, all owned by one city and without improvements or districts.
Build a @mechanic{Holy Site} and collect enough Faith to purchase two @mechanic{Naturalists}. Create parks covering Crater Lake and both Yosemite tiles.

achievements.description: Conquer a city with a Mamluk
achievements.summary: Capture a city with a Mamluk delivering the final attack.

steps.text: Play as Saladin and research Stirrups to train a @mechanic{Mamluk}. Weaken an enemy city or city-state, then capture the city with the Mamluk.

achievements.description: As Aztecs on a standard-sized map, attack an opponent while receiving a +16 Combat Strength bonus for having all of the luxuries
achievements.summary: Attack an enemy as the Aztecs on a Standard map with a +16 Combat Strength bonus from different luxury resources.

steps.text: Select Montezuma and @mechanic{Standard} map size. Acquire 16 different luxury resources; improved resources, Great Merchant luxuries and Zanzibar’s luxuries can contribute.
Save before the attack. Check that your unit receives the +16 luxury bonus, then attack an enemy unit or Barbarian.

achievements.description: Playing as Brazil, complete both Estadio Do Maracana and Christo Redentor in one city
achievements.summary: Complete Estadio do Maracana and Cristo Redentor in the same Brazilian city.

steps.text: Choose Pedro II and an Atomic Era start. Settle a city with a hill for @mechanic{Cristo Redentor} and flat land beside a future Street Carnival for @mechanic{Estadio do Maracana}.
Complete Cristo Redentor in that city. Research Professional Sports and build a Street Carnival with a Zoo and Stadium.
Build Estadio do Maracana on the reserved flat tile in the same city.

achievements.description: Playing as China, end a turn with 5 Crouching Tigers on Great Wall tiles
achievements.summary: End a turn as China with five Crouching Tigers each occupying a Great Wall tile.

steps.text: As Qin Shi Huang, research Masonry and Machinery. Use Builders to construct five @mechanic{Great Wall} tiles at your borders and train five @mechanic{Crouching Tigers}.
Place one Crouching Tiger on each of the five Great Wall tiles, then end the turn.

achievements.description: As Egypt build a Sphinx adjacent to the Pyramids both on Desert Floodplains
achievements.summary: Build a Sphinx beside the Pyramids as Egypt, with both on Desert Floodplains.

steps.text: As Cleopatra, reserve two adjacent @loc{Desert Floodplains} tiles. Research Masonry and build the @mechanic{Pyramids} on one tile.
Unlock the Sphinx with Craftsmanship. After the Pyramids finish, use a Builder to place a @mechanic{Sphinx} on the neighboring Desert Floodplains tile.

achievements.description: Airlift a level 3 Slinger
achievements.summary: Airlift a Slinger that has reached level 3.

steps.text: Train a @mechanic{Slinger} early and keep the unit alive without upgrading its unit type. Gain combat experience and apply promotions until the Slinger reaches level 3.
Research Flight, build Aerodromes with Airports in two cities, and unlock Rapid Deployment.
Use @mechanic{Airlift} to move the level-3 Slinger between the Airports.

achievements.description: Playing as England on a Huge map, have a city on every continent at the start of the turn
achievements.summary: Begin a turn as England with at least one city on every continent of a Huge map.

steps.text: Choose Victoria on a @mechanic{Huge} map. An Information Era start lets you launch a satellite to reveal the map.
Use the @mechanic{Continents} lens to find every continent and settle or capture a city on each one. Keep those cities until the next turn starts.

achievements.description: Create 5 Châteaux in one city with the Wine resource.
achievements.summary: Build five Châteaux belonging to one French city that has Wine.

guide.context: Use Standard Rules for this riverside placement route.

steps.text: Play as Catherine de Medici and settle a city with @item{Wine} and enough riverside tiles for five @mechanic{Châteaux}.
Research Irrigation and improve the Wine. Unlock Humanism and use Builders to construct five Châteaux within that city’s territory.

achievements.description: Playing as Frederick Barbarossa, conquer the city-state of Jerusalem
achievements.summary: Capture Jerusalem while playing as Frederick Barbarossa.

steps.text: Choose Frederick Barbarossa on a map containing the city-state of @loc{Jerusalem}, then conquer Jerusalem with your army.

achievements.description: Have 12 Policy Slots as Greece
achievements.summary: Fill twelve policy slots while playing as Greece.

steps.text: Choose Gorgo or Pericles. Adopt @mechanic{Democracy}, @mechanic{Communism} or @mechanic{Fascism} for eight government slots, plus Greece’s extra wildcard slot.
Build three policy-slot wonders from @mechanic{Alhambra}, @mechanic{Forbidden City}, @mechanic{Potala Palace} and @mechanic{Big Ben} to reach twelve slots.
Fill all twelve slots with policies. If the unlock does not appear, switch to another late-game government and fill the slots again.

achievements.description: Playing as India on a Huge map, receive +35 Faith in one turn from the Satyagraha ability
achievements.summary: Generate 35 Faith during a single turn through Satyagraha as Gandhi on a Huge map.

steps.text: Choose Huge map size for a local @mechanic{Hot Seat} match. Assign Gandhi to player one and add six human-controlled civilizations capable of founding religions.
Found a different religion with each of the seven civilizations. Keep every civilization at peace with every other civilization.
Have Gandhi meet the other six civilizations, then advance turns until @mechanic{Satyagraha} supplies 35 Faith in one turn.

achievements.description: Playing as Japan, have a district with 6 adjacent unpillaged districts
achievements.summary: Complete a Japanese district last in a cluster where six completed, unpillaged districts surround the central district.

steps.text: As Hojo Tokimune, reserve a central land tile with six surrounding tiles for districts. Build the six outer districts first and leave them unpillaged.
Complete the central district last, then advance one turn. The central district cannot be your City Center.

achievements.description: Playing as Kongo, have a capital city with a population of 30
achievements.summary: Grow Kongo’s capital to thirty population.

steps.text: Play as Mvemba a Nzinga and develop a food-rich capital. Send domestic Trade Routes from the capital to your other cities.
After Class Struggle, use @mechanic{Collectivization} for extra food from domestic Trade Routes. Keep growing the capital until its population reaches 30.

achievements.description: Capture a settler with a Viking Longship
achievements.summary: Capture a Settler using a Viking Longship.

steps.text: Start a local @mechanic{Hot Seat} game with Harald Hardrada as player one and another human-controlled civilization. Train a @mechanic{Viking Longship}.
Move the other player’s unescorted Settler onto a coastal land tile. Declare war, move the Longship beside the Settler, and use @mechanic{Coastal Raid} to capture the Settler.

achievements.displayName: Missed That Day in History Class
achievements.description: Clear nuclear contamination with a Roman Legion
achievements.summary: Remove nuclear fallout with a Roman Legion.

steps.text: As Trajan, train a @item{Legion} and keep the Legion safe without upgrading the unit.
Research Nuclear Fission, secure Uranium and complete the Manhattan Project followed by Build Nuclear Device. Save, then launch the device with a Bomber or Missile Silo.
Move the Legion onto fallout with enough movement left to use Remove Fallout immediately; radiation can kill the Legion if you wait. Reload the save from before the launch if the Legion dies.

achievements.description: Playing as Russia, have a city that is at least 60 tiles away from your capital, connected by a Trade Route and road at the start of the turn.
achievements.summary: As Russia, begin a turn with a city at least 60 tiles from the capital connected to the capital by a trade route and road.

steps.text: Choose Peter, a Huge land-heavy map, one opponent and no barbarians. Found the capital near one end of the landmass.
Settle a chain of cities no more than 14 land tiles apart. Run Traders along the chain to establish roads and trading posts that extend trade-route range.
Use the route selection distance to find a city at least 60 tiles from the capital. Run a trade route linking that city and the capital, complete the connecting road, then begin the next turn.

achievements.description: Playing as Scythia have 10 Saka Horse Archers in your army
achievements.summary: Have 10 Saka Horse Archers simultaneously as Scythia.

steps.text: Choose Tomyris and research Horseback Riding, or start in the Classical Era. Train five Saka Horse Archers to receive five additional copies from Scythia’s unit bonus; keep all 10 alive.

achievements.description: Launch an Inquisition as Spain
achievements.summary: Start an Inquisition while playing as Spain.

steps.text: As Philip II, found a religion and build a Holy Site with a Temple. Buy an Apostle with Faith and select @mechanic{Launch Inquisition}.

achievements.description: As Sumeria, have the first Great Work of Writing
achievements.summary: Create the first Great Work of Writing in the game as Sumeria.

steps.text: Choose Gilgamesh. Build a Theater Square and Amphitheater early, then run Theater Square projects to earn Great Writer points.
Recruit a Great Writer before another civilization creates a Great Work of Writing. Activate the writer at an available writing slot immediately.

achievements.description: Activate Darwin adjacent to the Galapagos Islands
achievements.summary: Use Charles Darwin’s ability on a tile adjacent to the Galápagos Islands.

steps.text: Start in the Industrial Era or earlier. Find the Galápagos Islands before committing to the match; on the Earth map, search near South America. Recruit the Industrial Era Great Scientist Charles Darwin.
Move Darwin onto a tile beside the Galápagos Islands and activate his ability there.

achievements.displayName: Oneth By Land Twoeth By Sea
achievements.description: Have an Army of land Units and 2 Armadas
achievements.summary: Have one land Army and two naval Armadas at the same time.

steps.text: Research Nationalism and Mobilization. Combine three matching land units into an Army and three matching naval units into each of two Armadas; keep all three formations.

achievements.description: Win a regular game on a Duel Map
achievements.summary: Win a regular game using the Duel map size.

steps.text: In Advanced Setup, set Map Size to @mechanic{Duel} and win the match.

For a short match, use Standard Rules, Settler difficulty and a custom turn limit of 1. Found the capital and end the turn. If the score is too low, retry with a 3–5 turn limit, keep Score Victory enabled and expand until you lead the score ranking.

For a short match, use Standard Rules, Settler difficulty and a custom turn limit of 1. Found the capital and end the turn. If the score is too low, retry with a 3–5 turn limit, keep Score Victory enabled and expand until you lead the score ranking.

achievements.description: Get 5 Tech boosts in 1 turn
achievements.summary: Trigger five technology Eurekas during a single turn.

steps.text: Use Standard Rules and start before the Information Era. Recruit the Information Era Great Scientist @npc{Abdus Salam}. Keep at least five Information Era technologies unresearched and without Eurekas.
Activate Abdus Salam to trigger the five Eurekas together.

achievements.description: Get 5 Civic boosts in 1 turn
achievements.summary: Trigger five civic Inspirations during a single turn.

steps.text: Use Standard Rules. In the Civic Tree, find the five civics with these Inspiration requirements: six Farms, two Markets, a city with 10 population, Astronomy researched and an Encampment built. Leave those civics unresearched and those Inspirations untriggered until the synchronized turn.
Stop at five Farms and one Market. Pause Astronomy and the Encampment with one turn remaining. Wait until the chosen city will reach 10 population next turn.
Resume Astronomy and the Encampment before ending that turn. On the new turn, build the sixth Farm and purchase the second Market to trigger all five Inspirations in that turn.

achievements.description: Use a bomber class unit to detonate a nuclear device, as long as its base and 9 Observation Balloons are located on the continent of Nena at the time of detonation.
achievements.summary: Detonate a nuclear device with a bomber while its base and nine Observation Balloons are on Nena.

steps.text: Use the Continents lens to locate a continent named @loc{Nena}. Establish a bomber base there and place nine Observation Balloons on Nena tiles.
Secure Uranium, complete the Manhattan Project and Build Nuclear Device, then base a Bomber on Nena.
With all nine balloons still on Nena, use that Bomber to drop the nuclear device on an enemy city.

achievements.description: Activate Leonardo da Vinci in New York with Great Works from Michelangelo and Donatello -- and a sewer -- all in that city
achievements.summary: In New York, use Leonardo da Vinci’s ability while the city has a Sewer and Great Works by Michelangelo and Donatello.

steps.text: Play as America and found cities until New York appears. Build an Art Museum in its Theater Square, an Industrial Zone and a Sewer unlocked by Sanitation.
Recruit Michelangelo, Donatello and Leonardo da Vinci. Create the artists’ works and place at least one work by each artist in New York’s museum.
Keep Leonardo unused until the Sewer and both works are in New York. Activate Leonardo in New York’s Industrial Zone.

achievements.displayName: Seven Wonders of the Post-Apocalyptic World
achievements.description: Launch a weapon of mass destruction and have it pillage seven wonders
achievements.summary: Pillage seven Wonders with one nuclear strike launched by a bomber.

steps.text: Start no later than the Industrial Era so enough Wonders remain available. Plan seven Wonders close enough to fit within a two-tile blast radius, using nearby cities if needed.
Secure Uranium and complete the Manhattan Project and Operation Ivy, then produce a Thermonuclear Device.
Launch the device with a @item{Jet Bomber} at the center of the cluster so the same blast pillages all seven Wonders.

achievements.description: Steal a Great Work of Art and don't get caught
achievements.summary: Steal a Great Work of Art with a Spy who escapes without being caught.

steps.text: Send a Spy to a foreign city containing a stealable Great Work of Art. Run Gain Sources to improve the chance of success, then select @mechanic{Great Work Heist}. The theft must succeed and the Spy must avoid capture.

achievements.description: Build every district type in one city and the Colosseum
achievements.summary: Construct every base-game district type and the Colosseum in one city.

steps.text: Use Standard Rules and an Ancient, Classical or Medieval Era start. Choose a city with water access and an Aqueduct site. Reserve flat land beside an Entertainment Complex for the Colosseum.

Build the Entertainment Complex, then the adjacent Colosseum before a rival takes the Wonder. Grow the city and add Campus, Holy Site, Commercial Hub, Industrial Zone, Theater Square and Encampment districts.

Complete the same city’s Harbor, Aqueduct, Neighborhood, Aerodrome and Spaceport. The Harbor needs water beside land; the Aqueduct needs the City Center and fresh water or a Mountain; the Spaceport needs flat land.

achievements.description: Play a multiplayer game
achievements.summary: Begin a multiplayer match.

steps.text: Open Multiplayer, create a local @mechanic{Hotseat} game and start the match; a victory is unnecessary.

achievements.description: Put two units into a formation
achievements.summary: Link two units into an escort formation.

steps.text: Place a Builder or Settler on the same tile as a military unit, then use the escort formation button to link the units.

achievements.displayName: If You Build It, They Will Come
achievements.description: Have 6 Improvements at one time.
achievements.summary: Own six tile improvements simultaneously.

steps.text: Use Builders to construct six tile improvements, such as Farms and Mines, and keep the six improvements in place together.

achievements.description: Found or conquer a city on a different continent
achievements.summary: Found or capture a city on a continent different from your starting continent.

steps.text: Use the Continents lens to find land on another continent, then settle a city there or capture an existing city.

achievements.description: At the start of the turn have an Ecstatic city.
achievements.summary: Begin a turn with a city at Ecstatic happiness.

steps.text: Supply a city with luxury resources and entertainment Amenities until the city panel shows @mechanic{Ecstatic}, then advance to the next turn.

achievements.description: Have an enemy city under siege at the start of the turn
achievements.summary: Have an enemy city under siege at the start of a turn.

steps.text: During a war, surround an enemy city so every adjacent passable tile is occupied by your units or covered by their zones of control. Check that the city shows @mechanic{Under Siege}, then end the turn and keep the siege in place until your next turn begins.

achievements.description: Declare a formal war
achievements.summary: Declare war using the Formal War option.

steps.text: Denounce another civilization, wait five turns, then select @mechanic{Declare Formal War} in diplomacy.

achievements.description: Name a unit
achievements.summary: Give a unit a custom name.

steps.text: Earn and apply two promotions to one unit, then use its name-edit button to enter a custom name.

achievements.description: Change your government
achievements.summary: Adopt a different government.

steps.text: Unlock a new government through civics, open the Government screen and adopt the new government.

achievements.description: Have top secret access with five civilizations in one game at once.
achievements.summary: Have Top Secret diplomatic visibility with five other civilizations simultaneously.

steps.text: Start with at least five opponents. Catherine de Medici’s extra diplomatic visibility makes this easier. Research Printing and establish friendly relations with the five civilizations.
Add embassies, trade routes and Spy Listening Posts to raise visibility. The Great Merchant Mary Katherine Goddard supplies another visibility level.
Check each civilization’s diplomatic access panel and maintain @mechanic{Top Secret} access with five at the same time.

achievements.description: Possess 6 Silver luxury resources at the start of the turn
achievements.summary: Begin a turn owning six copies of the Silver luxury resource.

steps.text: Find six Silver deposits, commonly on tundra or desert. Acquire the tiles and improve the deposits with Mines, then begin the next turn while controlling all six.

achievements.description: Become Suzerain of a City-State
achievements.summary: Become the Suzerain of a city-state.

steps.text: Meet a city-state and send at least three Envoys. Keep more Envoys there than every other civilization to become its Suzerain.

achievements.description: Win a regular game with a Science victory on any difficulty with any leader with a captured Egyptian city -- having also activated Newton and Darwin
achievements.summary: Win a Science Victory while owning a captured Egyptian city after activating Isaac Newton and Charles Darwin.

steps.text: Include Egypt as an opponent and start before the Renaissance Era. Recruit and activate Isaac Newton and Charles Darwin when their eras arrive.
Capture an Egyptian city and retain the city. Build a Spaceport and finish the science victory projects while keeping the captured city.

achievements.description: Win a regular game with a Religious victory with your dominant religion being Zoroastrianism and at the time of victory you are the Suzerain of Zanzibar
achievements.summary: Win a Religious Victory with Zoroastrianism while serving as Zanzibar’s Suzerain.

steps.text: Start a match containing Zanzibar, with one opponent for an easier religious victory. Found @mechanic{Zoroastrianism} before another civilization claims the religion name.
Send enough Envoys to Zanzibar to become and remain its Suzerain. Convert a majority of the cities in each civilization to Zoroastrianism to win.

achievements.description: Win a regular game with a Culture victory with your leader in the game as your opponent as well
achievements.summary: Win a Culture Victory against an opponent using the same leader as you.

steps.text: In Advanced Setup, choose the same leader for yourself and one opponent on a Duel map. Keep Culture Victory enabled.
Build tourism through Great Works and Wonders until your visiting tourists exceed the opponent’s domestic tourists.

achievements.description: Win a regular game with a Domination victory on any difficulty with any leader on a Huge Island Plates map.
achievements.summary: Win a Domination Victory on a Huge Island Plates map.

steps.text: Choose @mechanic{Island Plates} and @mechanic{Huge} in Advanced Setup. Leave one opponent for a shorter match and select a leader with naval strengths.
Locate and capture the opponent’s original capital. With more opponents, control every rival’s original capital simultaneously.

steps.text: Set Start Era to @mechanic{Ancient} in Advanced Setup before starting the match.

achievements.description: Build an Alcazar within 2 tiles of the Alhambra

steps.text: Become suzerain of @loc{Granada} so your Builders can construct Alcazars.
Research Castles and build @loc{Alhambra} on a hill beside an Encampment. Build an Alcazar within two tiles of the wonder.

achievements.description: Build a Monastery within 2 tiles of the Giant's Causeway
achievements.summary: Construct a Monastery no more than two tiles from the Giant’s Causeway.

steps.text: Use a map containing both @loc{Armagh} and @loc{Giant’s Causeway}. Settle close enough to own a buildable tile within two tiles of the natural wonder.
Become Armagh’s suzerain, then use a Builder to place a Monastery on that tile.

achievements.description: Build three Aerodromes within 2 tiles of Eyjafjallajökull
achievements.summary: Complete three Aerodromes no more than two tiles from Eyjafjallajökull.

steps.text: Locate @loc{Eyjafjallajökull} and plan three nearby cities, each able to place an Aerodrome on flat land within two tiles of the natural wonder.
Research Flight, then complete one Aerodrome in each of those cities.

achievements.displayName: Absolutely Nothing Rotten in the State of Denmark
achievements.description: Win Vikings, Traders, and Raiders! as Canute
achievements.summary: Finish Vikings, Traders, and Raiders! in first place as Canute.

steps.text: Choose Canute and Settler difficulty for @mechanic{Vikings, Traders, and Raiders!}. Train Berserkers to raid and conquer neighboring France.
Build Harbors and Commercial Hubs, establish trade routes, and pillage enemy coasts for income.
Research Knarrs to cross ocean tiles. Send Great Admirals to @loc{Vinland}, at the far western edge beyond Ireland, and activate them beside the wonder for victory points.
Finish the 60-turn scenario with the highest score.

achievements.description: Win Vikings, Traders, and Raiders! as Harald Hardrada
achievements.summary: Finish Vikings, Traders, and Raiders! in first place as Harald Hardrada.

steps.text: Choose Harald Hardrada and Settler difficulty for @mechanic{Vikings, Traders, and Raiders!}. Attack the British city-states from the north while your Longships pillage the coast.
Build Harbors and Commercial Hubs, establish trade routes, and pillage enemy coasts for income.

Build Harbors and Commercial Hubs, establish trade routes, and pillage enemy coasts for income.

steps.text: Choose Harald Hardrada on Deity. Research Great Heathen Army and Military Tactics for siege units and Berserkers, then take the northern British city-states.
Build Harbors and Commercial Hubs, establish trade routes, and pillage enemy coasts for income.
Research Knarrs to cross ocean tiles. Send Great Admirals to @loc{Vinland}, at the far western edge beyond Ireland, and activate them beside the wonder for victory points.
Finish the 60-turn scenario with the highest score.

achievements.description: Win a regular game as Jadwiga
achievements.summary: Claim any regular-game victory as Jadwiga.

steps.text: Choose Jadwiga in Advanced Setup and use Standard Rules. Set the custom turn limit to 1, found your capital, and end the turn for a score victory.
If the opening score is too low, restart in the Atomic Era and buy tiles before ending the turn.

achievements.description: Playing as Poland, destroy another civilization's incomplete wonder by initiating a Culture Bomb
achievements.summary: Use Poland’s Culture Bomb to erase a rival civilization’s unfinished wonder.

steps.text: Set up a duel Hotseat game with Poland as Player 1 and another human-controlled civilization. Put their borders together.

Have the other civilization begin a wonder beside a Polish tile. Complete a Polish Encampment next to the unfinished wonder to claim its tile and destroy construction. If the wonder finishes first, have the other civilization start another wonder beside Polish territory and target that unfinished wonder instead.

achievements.description: Win Jadwiga's Legacy as Stanislaw Potocki
achievements.summary: Win Jadwiga’s Legacy while playing Stanislaw Potocki.

steps.text: Select Stanislaw Potocki in @mechanic{Jadwiga’s Legacy} on Settler.
Found cities near @loc{Wien} and defend the city-state with Crossbowmen in cities and Encampments. Finish weakened invaders with Winged Hussars.
Build Commercial Hubs and trade routes to support your army. Fortify northern cities before Swedish Musketmen arrive.
Keep Wien standing and hold the highest score when turn 60 ends.

achievements.description: Playing as Australia, build a Pasture over Sheep and steal an adjacent player's Lumbermill
achievements.summary: Use an Australian Sheep Pasture to claim another civilization’s adjacent Lumber Mill.

steps.text: In a duel Hotseat game, assign Australia to Player 1 and find Sheep beside Woods. Settle Australia so it owns the Sheep and settle the other civilization so it owns the Woods.
Have the other civilization build a Lumber Mill on the Woods. Buy the other tiles around the Sheep as Australia, then save before placing the Pasture.
Build a Pasture on the Sheep to claim the Lumber Mill through a Culture Bomb. Reload the save if the mill is not claimed.

achievements.description: Win Outback Tycoon as Queensland
achievements.summary: Win Outback Tycoon while playing Queensland.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Outback Tycoon} as Queensland on Settler.
Found several cities beside Woods. Keep those Woods for the final production push; develop Commercial Hubs, domestic trade routes, and Outback Stations.
After World War II arrives on turn 53, adopt the Invasion Threat policy card and complete AIF Training projects. Chop the saved Woods to finish more projects; each now adds 20 Gold per turn.
Adopt the Flying Doctors and Parramatta Road policy cards. Set cities to produce Gold on the final turn and reach the scenario’s required Gold per turn.

steps.text: Start Outback Tycoon on Deity. In single player, aim for at least @mechanic{900 Gold per turn} before the 60-turn limit.
Found several cities beside Woods. Keep those Woods for the final production push; develop Commercial Hubs, domestic trade routes, and Outback Stations.

achievements.description: Complete an online multiplayer game of Outback Tycoon
achievements.summary: Finish a multiplayer match of Outback Tycoon.

steps.text: Choose the @mechanic{Outback Tycoon} rules for a new Hotseat match. Set each of the four factions to human control.
Play all four factions through the scenario’s end; multiplayer uses the highest income to decide the winner.

achievements.description: Build an Oil Well on the final turn of the Outback Tycoon scenario
achievements.summary: Place an Oil Well during Outback Tycoon’s last turn.

steps.text: After turn 53’s World War II event, research Combustion and send a Prospector to an unimproved Oil resource.
Wait until @mechanic{turn 60}, then use the Prospector to build the Oil Well before ending the turn.

achievements.description: Lose a unit to the perils of Australia in the Outback Tycoon scenario
achievements.summary: Have a unit killed by an Australian hazard during Outback Tycoon.

steps.text: Keep exploring in @mechanic{Outback Tycoon} until a random Australian peril kills one of your units. Damage or lost movement alone does not count.

steps.text: Create a Medieval-start duel Hotseat match with Macedon as Player 1 and another human-controlled civilization. Give the other civilization a coastal city with space for both wonders.
In that city, build a Harbor and Lighthouse for the Great Lighthouse, plus a Campus and Library for the Great Library. Complete both wonders.
Declare war as Alexander and capture that city.

achievements.description: Playing as Persia, conquer the original Scythian capital within 10 turns of declaring a surprise war on Scythia
achievements.summary: Take Scythia’s original capital as Persia within ten turns of starting a surprise war against Scythia.

steps.text: Choose Cyrus with Tomyris as your duel opponent. Find Scythia’s original capital and assemble your army nearby before declaring war.
Declare a @mechanic{Surprise War}, then capture the original capital within ten turns. If using Hotseat to control Scythia’s defense, assign Cyrus to Player 1.

achievements.description: After building the Apadana wonder, construct 7 additional wonders in the same city
achievements.summary: Finish Apadana and then seven more wonders in Apadana’s city.

steps.text: Choose a city with space and terrain for eight wonders. Research Political Philosophy and complete @loc{Apadana} there first.
Complete seven further wonders in that same city. Wonders finished before Apadana do not count.

achievements.description: Win Conquests of Alexander on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Win the Conquests of Alexander scenario.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Conquests of Alexander} on Settler for a 60-turn limit. Capture all 28 cities before time runs out.
Push through Persian Anatolia, then split your forces toward Egypt and east through Mesopotamia. Keep Great Generals supporting the fighting units.
After Babylon, send armies toward both Marakanda and Patala. Capture cities containing wonders to heal your units; bring a strong force against Patala’s Varu.

achievements.description: Achieve the highest possible rank in Conquests of Alexander at Deity difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish Conquests of Alexander on Deity with the highest rank, worth at least 200 points.

steps.text: Select Deity in @mechanic{Conquests of Alexander}. Conquer the map while training Settlers for additional cities.
Push through Persian Anatolia, then split your forces toward Egypt and east through Mesopotamia. Keep Great Generals supporting the fighting units.
After Babylon, send armies toward both Marakanda and Patala. Capture cities containing wonders to heal your units; bring a strong force against Patala’s Varu.
Raise the displayed score to at least @mechanic{200} before the final conquest ends the scenario. Cities add five points, so keep founding cities until the score reaches the threshold.

achievements.displayName: He Named Them All After Himself?
achievements.description: Settle four cities in Conquests of Alexander on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Found four new cities during Conquests of Alexander.

steps.text: In @mechanic{Conquests of Alexander}, train three Settlers to join your starting Settler. Found four cities; raze conquered cities if you need settlement space.

achievements.description: Possess all of the following after conquering a city in Conquests of Alexander: Hoplite, Saka Horse Archer, Maryannu Chariot Archer, Immortal, and Varu
achievements.summary: Simultaneously control all five unique city-capture reward unit types in Conquests of Alexander.

steps.text: Put the Great General @npc{Alexander} next to each target city when you capture it to receive its special units.
Capture @loc{Athens} for Hoplites, @loc{Pasargadae} for Immortals, and @loc{Memphis} for a Maryannu Chariot Archer.
Capture @loc{Marakanda} for a Saka Horse Archer and @loc{Patala} for a Varu. Keep at least one unit of every required type alive until you own the full set.

achievements.displayName: I Quenched Your Thirst For Blood
achievements.description: Playing as Scythia, recapture one of your founded cities from Persia
achievements.summary: As Scythia, take back a city you founded after Persia has owned that city.

steps.text: In a duel Hotseat game, choose Tomyris as Player 1 and Cyrus as the opponent. Found a Scythian city close to Persia and let Persia capture the city.
Retake that city with Scythian forces.

achievements.description: Win a regular game as Amanitore
achievements.summary: Claim any regular-game victory as Amanitore.

steps.text: Choose Amanitore in Advanced Setup and use Standard Rules. Set the custom turn limit to 1, found your capital, and end the turn for a score victory.
If the opening score is too low, restart in the Atomic Era and buy tiles before ending the turn.

achievements.description: As Nubia, earn six different adjacency bonuses on a Nubian Pyramid
achievements.summary: Give one Nubian Pyramid six different adjacency bonuses while playing Nubia.

steps.text: Plan a desert tile beside a City Center. Reserve its other five neighboring tiles for a Holy Site, Theater Square, Campus, Industrial Zone, and Commercial Hub.
Build the Campus, Commercial Hub, Industrial Zone, and Theater Square. Place the @mechanic{Nubian Pyramid} on the reserved tile, then complete the Holy Site last.

achievements.description: Playing as Egypt in a regular game, conquer the original Nubian capital within 10 turns of declaring a formal war on Nubia
achievements.summary: As Egypt, declare formal war against Nubia and seize Nubia’s original capital within the next ten turns.

steps.text: Start a Standard Rules duel as Cleopatra against Amanitore. Locate Nubia’s original capital and prepare ranged units, siege units, and a capturing melee unit nearby.
Denounce Nubia and wait five turns. Declare a @mechanic{Formal War} rather than a Surprise War, then take the original capital within ten turns.

achievements.description: Playing as Nubia, liberate the original Egyptian capital in a liberation war with the capital's conqueror
achievements.summary: As Nubia, liberate Egypt’s original capital during a liberation war against the civilization holding the capital.

steps.text: Set up a Standard Rules Hotseat game with Nubia as human-controlled Player 1, another human-controlled civilization, and AI-controlled Egypt. As Nubia, research Diplomatic Service and become Egypt’s declared friend.
Use the third civilization to conquer Egypt’s original capital. As Nubia, declare a @mechanic{Liberation War} against that conqueror.
Capture Egypt’s original capital and choose to liberate the city.

achievements.description: After building the Jebel Barkal wonder, earn 28 Faith per turn on its tile
achievements.summary: Raise the Faith yield of Jebel Barkal’s tile to 28 per turn.

steps.text: Reserve a Desert Hills tile for @loc{Jebel Barkal}. Found seven cities whose City Centers are all within six tiles of that wonder tile.
Complete Jebel Barkal and advance a turn. Measure the six-tile radius from the wonder, not its city’s center.

achievements.displayName: More Wind for the Wind God
achievements.description: Win Gifts of the Nile on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Achieve a victory in Gifts of the Nile.

steps.text: Start @mechanic{Gifts of the Nile} on Settler. Use the seven-temple victory route.
Acquire seven cities by using the Settlers awarded through technologies and civics, then conquering a city-state for any missing city. Settlers cannot be trained.
Place a Holy Site in each city. Buy its religious buildings with Faith until you can buy a @mechanic{Temple to Amon}; build seven Temples to Amon before the 125-turn limit.
Send envoys to religious city-states and buy the earlier Faith buildings promptly to increase Faith income. Defend your cities while completing the temples.

achievements.description: Playing Gifts of the Nile as Egypt, win on Deity difficulty
achievements.summary: Win Gifts of the Nile as Egypt on Deity.

steps.text: Choose Cleopatra on Deity in @mechanic{Gifts of the Nile}. Settle the Nile Delta and defend the northern approaches against invaders.
Acquire seven cities by using the Settlers awarded through technologies and civics, then conquering a city-state for any missing city. Settlers cannot be trained.
Place a Holy Site in each city. Buy its religious buildings with Faith until you can buy a @mechanic{Temple to Amon}; build seven Temples to Amon before the 125-turn limit.
Send envoys to religious city-states and buy the earlier Faith buildings promptly to increase Faith income. Defend your cities while completing the temples.

achievements.description: Playing Gifts of the Nile as Nubia, win on Deity difficulty
achievements.summary: Win Gifts of the Nile as Nubia on Deity.

steps.text: Choose Amanitore on Deity in @mechanic{Gifts of the Nile}. Settle the southern Nile and improve Nubian Pyramids for Faith.
Acquire seven cities by using the Settlers awarded through technologies and civics, then conquering a city-state for any missing city. Settlers cannot be trained.
Place a Holy Site in each city. Buy its religious buildings with Faith until you can buy a @mechanic{Temple to Amon}; build seven Temples to Amon before the 125-turn limit.
Send envoys to religious city-states and buy the earlier Faith buildings promptly to increase Faith income. Defend your cities while completing the temples.

achievements.description: Playing Gifts of the Nile as Nubia, found a coastal city on the Mediterranean Sea
achievements.summary: Establish a Nubian city on the Mediterranean coast in Gifts of the Nile.

steps.text: Choose Amanitore in @mechanic{Gifts of the Nile}. Obtain a Settler from Medicine or a civic reward and escort the Settler north along the Nile.
Found a city on the @loc{Mediterranean Sea} coast at the northern edge of the map.

achievements.displayName: From Med to Red to the Land of the Dead
achievements.description: Playing Gifts of the Nile as Egypt, conquer Irem and Punt
achievements.summary: Capture both Irem and Punt as Egypt in Gifts of the Nile.

steps.text: Choose Cleopatra in @mechanic{Gifts of the Nile}. Follow the Nile south to @loc{Irem}, near the middle of the map’s southern edge, and capture the city.
Take @loc{Punt} on the Red Sea coast, around the middle of the eastern edge.

achievements.description: Win a regular game as Jayavarman VII
achievements.summary: Claim any regular-game victory as Jayavarman VII.

steps.text: Choose Jayavarman VII in Advanced Setup and use Standard Rules. Set the custom turn limit to 1, found your capital, and end the turn for a score victory.
If the opening score is too low, restart in the Atomic Era and buy tiles before ending the turn.

achievements.displayName: All Beneath the Wings of Garuda
achievements.description: Win a regular game as Gitarja
achievements.summary: Claim any regular-game victory as Gitarja.

steps.text: Choose Gitarja in Advanced Setup and use Standard Rules. Set the custom turn limit to 1, found your capital, and end the turn for a score victory.
If the opening score is too low, restart in the Atomic Era and buy tiles before ending the turn.

achievements.description: Win the Path to Nirvana scenario on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Win a Path to Nirvana scenario.

steps.text: Choose Settler difficulty in @mechanic{Path to Nirvana}.
Build Commercial Hubs, Markets, and trade routes early. Use trade routes to influence nearby city-states and develop Faith income.
Purchase Monks and support them with Gurus. Win theological battles to remove rival influence and convert cities; spend accumulated Faith on more units.
Finish turn 50 with the most Victory Points. Faith income contributes 1 point for each Faith per turn. Each citizen of your religion adds 1 point; each foreign city of your religion adds 20 points.

achievements.description: Win the Path to Nirvana scenario on Deity
achievements.summary: Win a Path to Nirvana scenario on Deity.

steps.text: Select Indonesia or the Ghaznavids on Deity in @mechanic{Path to Nirvana}. Defend and develop your infrastructure during the first half of the scenario.
Build Commercial Hubs, Markets, and trade routes early. Use trade routes to influence nearby city-states and develop Faith income.
Purchase Monks and support them with Gurus. Win theological battles to remove rival influence and convert cities; spend accumulated Faith on more units.
Finish turn 50 with the most Victory Points. Faith income contributes 1 point for each Faith per turn. Each citizen of your religion adds 1 point; each foreign city of your religion adds 20 points.

achievements.description: Build Angkor Wat and a Wat in Angkor Wat
achievements.summary: Complete the Angkor Wat wonder and a Wat worship building in the Khmer city naturally named Angkor Wat.

steps.text: Play Jayavarman VII and found cities until one receives the name @loc{Angkor Wat}. Renaming a city does not count; choose a site with room for an Aqueduct and the wonder.
Found a religion with the @mechanic{Wat} worship belief. Build an Aqueduct in Angkor Wat, then complete the Angkor Wat wonder in that city.
Build the city’s Holy Site and Prasat, then add the Wat worship building.

achievements.description: Have 5 cities on landmasses 5 or less tiles with Indonesia
achievements.summary: Control five Indonesian cities on landmasses containing no more than five land tiles each.

steps.text: Choose Gitarja on an Archipelago map. Find islands with at most five land tiles and found five cities on those small landmasses.

achievements.displayName: Try To Snatch the Pebble From My Hand
achievements.description: Have a Warrior Monk with 4 Promotions
achievements.summary: Give a single Warrior Monk four promotions.

steps.text: When founding your religion, select @mechanic{Warrior Monks} as its follower belief. Buy a Warrior Monk with Faith in a city that follows your religion and has a Temple in its Holy Site.
Fight military units with that Monk until four promotions are available and take each promotion. In Hotseat, Player 1 must own and promote the Monk; the other player can provide safe enemy targets.

achievements.description: With a Guru Heal 7 religious units with one action
achievements.summary: Restore health to seven religious units with one Guru healing action.

steps.text: In a city with a majority religion and a Temple-equipped Holy Site, spend Faith to buy a Guru. Let enemy religious units wound the Guru and six other religious units without killing them.
Place the Guru in the center with the six injured units on the six adjacent tiles. Use the Guru’s heal action; the injured Guru supplies the seventh healed unit.

achievements.description: Build all 3 Wonders in the Paths to Nirvana scenario
achievements.summary: Complete every wonder available in a single Path to Nirvana scenario.

steps.text: Choose China in @mechanic{Path to Nirvana}. Research Craftsmanship for Mahabodhi Temple, Construction for Angkor Wat, and Astronomy for Potala Palace.
Build @loc{Angkor Wat} and @loc{Potala Palace} in Chang’an, then @loc{Mahabodhi Temple} in Kaifeng before the scenario ends.

achievements.displayName: Do You Have A Moment To Talk About Salvation?
achievements.description: Convert 3 opposing Holy Cities in the Paths to Nirvana scenario
achievements.summary: Convert three rival Holy Cities during one Path to Nirvana scenario.

steps.text: Play China on Settler in @mechanic{Path to Nirvana}. Build up religious units and use theological victories to weaken rival religions.
Convert @loc{Lhasa}, @loc{Bikrampur}, and @loc{Angkor Thom}. These are rival religion-founding capitals, rather than religious city-states.

achievements.description: Win a regular game as Shaka
achievements.summary: Win a regular match while leading as Shaka.

steps.text: Choose Shaka, the Rise and Fall ruleset, Settler difficulty and a Modern Era start. Leave Score Victory enabled and set a custom limit of 5 turns.
Found cities with your starting Settlers. Raise your score above your opponent before the turn limit ends.

achievements.summary: Win a regular match while leading as Chandragupta.

achievements.description: Win a regular game on the Archipelago Map
achievements.summary: Win a regular match on the Archipelago map using the Rise and Fall ruleset.

steps.text: Set the map to @loc{Archipelago} and the ruleset to Rise and Fall. For a short match, use Settler difficulty, a Modern Era start and a 5-turn limit with Score Victory enabled.
Found your starting cities and lead the score ranking when the turn limit ends.

achievements.description: As Lautaro, capture Philip II's original capital city
achievements.summary: Capture Philip II’s original capital while playing as Lautaro.

steps.text: Create a match with Lautaro and Philip II. Hot Seat lets you control both sides locally.
As Lautaro, capture @loc{Madrid}, Philip II’s original capital.

achievements.displayName: Buying your Deels and Listening to Your Throat Singing
achievements.description: As Genghis, win a Cultural Victory
achievements.summary: Achieve a Culture Victory as Genghis Khan.

steps.text: Play Genghis Khan on a Duel map at Settler difficulty. Keep only Culture Victory enabled.

Build wonders and develop tourism through Great Writers, Artists and Musicians. Use tourism policies and watch the Culture Victory panel until your visiting tourists exceed your rival’s domestic tourists.

achievements.description: As Wilhelmina, have seven cities and seven Zeven de Provincien at the start of the turn
achievements.summary: Begin a turn as Wilhelmina owning seven Zeven de Provincien naval units and exactly seven cities.

steps.text: Start as Wilhelmina in the Industrial Era. Keep exactly seven cities, including a coastal city that can produce @item{Zeven de Provincien}.
Build seven Zeven de Provincien and end the turn while retaining all seven ships and exactly seven cities.

achievements.description: Build a Golf Course in a tile where you had previously attempted to build a Wonder, but got beaten to the Wonder by another Civ
achievements.summary: Build a Golf Course on a tile where another civilization beat you to an unfinished wonder.

steps.text: Start a Modern Era Hot Seat match with Robert the Bruce and a second human-controlled civilization. Begin a wonder on a tile where Scotland can build a @item{Golf Course}.
Have the other civilization finish that same wonder first.
Use a Scottish Builder to place a Golf Course on the tile where Scotland’s unfinished wonder disappeared.

achievements.description: As Poundmaker, have an active Alliance of every type
achievements.summary: Maintain all five types of Alliance simultaneously as Poundmaker.

steps.text: Play Poundmaker with at least five other civilizations. Use Rise and Fall rules and an Industrial Era or later start for a quick diplomatic setup.
Establish embassies and declare friendships. Arrange one Alliance of each type: Military, Religious, Cultural, Economic and Research.
Renew expiring Alliances until all five types are active together.

achievements.displayName: I Thought We'd Moved Past This Joke
achievements.description: As Chandragupta, launch a nuclear weapon
achievements.summary: Detonate a nuclear weapon while playing as Chandragupta.

steps.text: Start as Chandragupta in the Information Era and secure Uranium. Complete @mechanic{Manhattan Project}, then @mechanic{Build Nuclear Device}.
Build an Aerodrome and a Jet Bomber; research Stealth Technology if needed. Use the bomber to launch the nuclear device at a target within range.

achievements.description: As Seondeok, build a Spaceport district next to a Seowon
achievements.summary: Place a Spaceport beside a Seowon while playing as Seondeok.

steps.text: Start as Seondeok in the Information Era. Build a @mechanic{Seowon} and a @mechanic{Spaceport} on adjacent tiles.

achievements.description: As Shaka, train a Corps of Impi using the Ikanda district
achievements.summary: Produce an Impi Corps from an Ikanda as Shaka.

steps.text: As Shaka, build an @mechanic{Ikanda}, research Military Tactics and unlock Mercenaries.
In that city’s production menu, train an @item{Impi Corps} directly.

achievements.description: As Tamar, have every city-state in the game following the religion you founded
achievements.summary: Make every city-state follow your founded religion while playing as Tamar.

steps.text: Start as Tamar with only one city-state to reduce the conversion work. Found your own religion.
Build a Holy Site and Shrine, then use Missionaries to make the city-state follow your religion.

achievements.description: Have a Governor with every promotion
achievements.summary: Give one Governor every available promotion.

steps.text: Start in the Information Era for plentiful Governor titles. Appoint one Governor, then spend titles on every promotion in that Governor’s tree.

achievements.description: Unlock every Governor, and have them established at the same time before the game reaches the Industrial Era
achievements.summary: Establish every Governor simultaneously before the world reaches the Industrial Era.

steps.text: Enable Rise and Fall and disable other gameplay expansions for this match. Use Rise and Fall rules and found seven cities. Earn Governor titles through civics and Government Plaza buildings.
Appoint each Governor and assign each to a different city. Wait for every establishment timer to finish before the world enters the Industrial Era.

achievements.description: Join or be the target of 3 Emergencies in a single game
achievements.summary: Participate in three Emergencies as a member or target during one match.

guide.context: You only need to participate; winning the Emergencies is unnecessary.

steps.text: Use a large Rise and Fall match with many civilizations. Accept Emergency invitations or become an Emergency target until you have participated three times in the same match.

achievements.displayName: Curse your sudden but inevitable betrayal!
achievements.description: Join a Betrayal Emergency
achievements.summary: Join an Emergency triggered by an Alliance betrayal.

steps.text: Start a Hot Seat match using Rise and Fall rules with two human-controlled civilizations and at least one AI civilization. Have both human civilizations build a level 2 Alliance with the AI.
Use the first human civilization to declare war on the AI after their Alliance ends. When a @mechanic{Betrayal Emergency} against that attacker is offered, join it as the second human civilization.

achievements.description: As France, build an Intelligence Agency
achievements.summary: Construct an Intelligence Agency while playing France.

steps.text: Play France and construct a Government Plaza. Add any first-tier Plaza building.
Adopt a tier 2 government, then construct the @mechanic{Intelligence Agency} in the Government Plaza.

achievements.description: Achieve the maximum Alliance level with Gilgamesh
achievements.summary: Reach Alliance level 3 with Gilgamesh.

steps.text: Include Gilgamesh in a Rise and Fall match. Establish friendship and then an Alliance with him.
Renew the Alliance whenever it expires until the relationship reaches @mechanic{level 3}.

achievements.description: Neutralize a Governor with a Spy
achievements.summary: Successfully neutralize an enemy Governor using a Spy.

steps.text: Send a Spy to an opponent’s city with a Governor. Use @mechanic{Gain Sources} to improve the odds, then complete @mechanic{Neutralize Governor} successfully.

achievements.description: Build a Fishery adjacent to the Great Barrier Reef
achievements.summary: Create a Fishery on a tile beside the Great Barrier Reef.

steps.text: Find the @loc{Great Barrier Reef} and settle close enough to own an adjacent Coast or Lake tile without a Reef feature.
Appoint Liang in that city and give her the @mechanic{Aquaculture} promotion. Once Liang is established, use a Builder to construct a Fishery beside the natural wonder.

achievements.description: Make a peace deal which includes you giving or receiving an Olives resource
achievements.summary: Include Olives in a peace agreement, either giving or receiving the resource.

steps.text: Use Rise and Fall rules. Improve an @item{Olives} resource or find an opponent who has Olives, then go to war.
Negotiate peace and include Olives on either side of the accepted deal.

achievements.description: Have 10 Shopping Malls in your civilization at the same time
achievements.summary: Own ten Shopping Malls at the same time.

steps.text: Develop ten cities. Unlock Urbanization and Capitalism, then build a Neighborhood and @mechanic{Shopping Mall} in each city.
Keep all ten Shopping Malls simultaneously. Avoid Food Markets in those cities, since a city cannot have both buildings.

achievements.displayName: Desperate Times Call For Desperate Measures
achievements.description: Assign a Dark Policy to your Government
achievements.summary: Equip a Dark Age policy card in your government.

steps.text: Finish an era below the Normal Age threshold to enter a Dark Age. Put one available @mechanic{Dark Age policy} into a wildcard slot and confirm your government.

achievements.description: Gain control of an Ally's city after it becomes disloyal, and choose to keep it
achievements.summary: Accept and retain a city that rebels against your ally and then joins your civilization.

steps.text: Maintain an Alliance with a civilization whose border city faces strong Loyalty pressure from your nearby cities.
Let that city rebel and eventually offer to join you. Choose to @mechanic{keep the city} when the decision appears.

achievements.description: Be the first player to circumnavigate the world after Ferdinand Magellan has been recruited by another player
achievements.summary: Become the first civilization to circumnavigate the world after someone else recruits Ferdinand Magellan.

steps.text: Create a Renaissance Era Hot Seat match on an Archipelago map with two human-controlled civilizations.
Have the second civilization earn Great Admiral points through Harbors and the Great Admiral policy, then recruit @npc{Ferdinand Magellan} when he is available.
Only after Magellan is recruited, use your first civilization’s ships to complete the world’s first circumnavigation.

achievements.description: Win the game while in a Dark Age
achievements.summary: Secure victory while your civilization is in a Dark Age.

guide.context: Use an early era for the win; a late-era age reset can prevent the achievement from registering.

steps.text: Start an Ancient Era Duel match at Settler difficulty with only Domination Victory enabled. Prepare troops near the rival capital while keeping Era Score below the Normal Age threshold.
Once the Classical Era begins and you enter a Dark Age, capture the rival’s original capital to win.

achievements.description: As England, lose a city to disloyalty which has an established Financier Governor
achievements.summary: Lose an English city to a Loyalty rebellion while Reyna is established there.

steps.text: As England, settle beside a rival’s population centers on a tile showing −20 Loyalty pressure in the settlement lens.
Establish @npc{Reyna} before the city’s Loyalty reaches zero. Check that Loyalty continues to fall with Reyna present, then leave her established until the city rebels.

achievements.displayName: Victory Belongs to the Most Persevering
achievements.description: Achieve a Heroic Age
achievements.summary: Enter a Heroic Age.

steps.text: Finish an era below the Normal Age threshold to enter a Dark Age.
During that Dark Age, earn enough Era Score to reach the Golden Age threshold. When the next era begins, you enter a @mechanic{Heroic Age}.

achievements.displayName: I'm going to break the wheel
achievements.description: Earn three Golden Ages in a row
achievements.summary: Enter Golden Ages in three consecutive eras.

steps.text: On a low difficulty, earn enough Era Score to reach the Golden Age threshold for three consecutive era transitions.
Use historic moments from exploration, wonders and unique units to add Era Score. Build @mechanic{Taj Mahal} to increase the score from historic moments worth at least 2 points.

achievements.description: Have an improved Amber resource in a city with a Zoo and an Archaeological Museum at the start of the turn
achievements.summary: Begin a turn with improved Amber, a Zoo and an Archaeological Museum belonging to the same city.

steps.text: Start in the Information Era and settle a city with @item{Amber}. Improve the resource.
Build a Zoo and an Archaeological Museum in that city, then end the turn while keeping the improvement and both buildings.

achievements.description: Completely surround your Government Plaza with districts or wonders you own at the start of the turn
achievements.summary: Begin a turn with all six tiles around your Government Plaza occupied by your districts or wonders.

steps.text: Place your @mechanic{Government Plaza} where all six neighboring tiles can hold your districts or wonders.
Fill every adjacent tile with a district or wonder you own, then end the turn. Multiple Neighborhoods can fill suitable spaces.

achievements.description: Win a game as Mansa Musa
achievements.summary: Win a match while playing as Mansa Musa.

steps.text: Select Mansa Musa with Gathering Storm rules, Settler difficulty and a Modern Era start. Enable only Score Victory and set a custom limit of 3–5 turns.
Settle your starting cities and finish the final turn with the highest score.

achievements.summary: Win a match while playing as Pachacuti.

steps.text: Select Pachacuti with Gathering Storm rules, Settler difficulty and a Modern Era start. Enable only Score Victory and set a custom limit of 3–5 turns.
Settle your starting cities and finish the final turn with the highest score.

steps.text: Select Suleiman the Magnificent with Gathering Storm rules, Settler difficulty and a Modern Era start. Enable only Score Victory and set a custom limit of 3–5 turns.

achievements.summary: Win a match while playing as Eleanor of Aquitaine.

steps.text: Select Eleanor of Aquitaine with Gathering Storm rules, Settler difficulty and a Modern Era start. Enable only Score Victory and set a custom limit of 3–5 turns.
