achievements.displayName: The Laurels of Virtues and Letters
achievements.description: Win a game as Matthias Corvinus
achievements.summary: Win a match while playing as Matthias Corvinus.

steps.text: Select Matthias Corvinus with Gathering Storm rules, Settler difficulty and a Modern Era start. Enable only Score Victory and set a custom limit of 3–5 turns.
Settle your starting cities and finish the final turn with the highest score.

achievements.description: Win a game as Kupe
achievements.summary: Win a match while playing as Kupe.

steps.text: Select Kupe with Gathering Storm rules, Settler difficulty and a Modern Era start. Enable only Score Victory and set a custom limit of 3–5 turns.
Settle your starting cities and finish the final turn with the highest score.

achievements.displayName: The Art of Telling Plain Truths
achievements.description: Win a Diplomatic Victory
achievements.summary: Reach 20 Diplomatic Victory points before another leader.

steps.text: Use Gathering Storm rules and keep Diplomatic Victory enabled.
Build up Diplomatic Favor and vote for winning World Congress outcomes. Support resolutions awarding you victory points and win Aid Requests or scored competitions.
Build the Statue of Liberty for four points, Potala Palace for one and Mahabodhi Temple for two. Keep earning points until you reach 20.

achievements.description: Playing as Russia, conquer a city with an Ice Hockey rink
achievements.summary: As Russia, capture a city that contains an Ice Hockey Rink.

steps.text: Set up a local Hot Seat match with Russia and Canada, both controlled by humans, starting in the Atomic Era.
As Canada, use a Builder to place an Ice Hockey Rink on Snow in a Canadian city. As Russia, declare war and capture that city.

achievements.description: Use two cities and the Panama Canal to make 7 contiguous land tiles passable by ships
achievements.summary: Connect seven consecutive land tiles for ships using two cities and the Panama Canal.

steps.text: Find seven flat, resource-free land tiles in a line between two bodies of water. A late start and a revealed map make the search easier.
From one shore, arrange the seven tiles as Canal, city, Panama Canal extension, Panama Canal wonder, Panama Canal extension, city, Canal.
Settle the two city tiles, connect their outside edges to water with Canal districts, then complete the Panama Canal across the middle three tiles.

achievements.description: Have a Canal, Dam, Aqueduct, Railroad, Golden Gate Bridge, and Mountain Tunnel in a city
achievements.summary: In one city, build a Mountain Tunnel, Golden Gate Bridge, Railroad, Aqueduct, Dam and Canal.

steps.text: Start in the Atomic Era and save before settling. Find a site with a mountain, river floodplains and a coastal strait for the Golden Gate Bridge. Check district and wonder placements after settling; reload the save if the site cannot fit everything.

Place the Aqueduct beside the City Center and fresh water or a mountain. Place the Dam on floodplains with the river along two tile edges. Build the Canal on flat land linking water to the city or another body of water.
Build the Golden Gate Bridge across a Coast tile between directly opposite land tiles, with water beside each end. A Lake cannot host the bridge.
Use a Military Engineer to add a Mountain Tunnel within the city and two adjacent Railroad tiles. Railroads consume Coal and Iron.

achievements.description: Have a fully upgraded Giant Death Robot capture a city
achievements.summary: Capture a city with a Giant Death Robot that has all four technology upgrades.

steps.text: Research Advanced AI, Advanced Power Cells, Cybernetics and Smart Materials to unlock the four Giant Death Robot upgrades.
Supply your Giant Death Robot with Uranium and use the robot to take the city, including the final capture attack.

achievements.displayName: A Man A Plan A Canal Panama
achievements.description: Build the Panama Canal as Teddy Roosevelt
achievements.summary: Complete the Panama Canal while playing as Teddy Roosevelt.

steps.text: Choose Teddy Roosevelt and a Modern Era start. Find a legal flat-land Panama Canal site linking water on both sides.
Select the Panama Canal in city production and finish construction.

achievements.description: Move a military unit into an enemy's owned tile using a Mountain Tunnel (or Qhapaq Nan)
achievements.summary: Use a Mountain Tunnel or Qhapaq Ñan to move a military unit into enemy territory.

steps.text: In a local Hot Seat match, settle opposing cities on either side of mountains and declare war. Start late enough to have Chemistry.
Train a Military Engineer through an Encampment with Barracks and Armory, then build the Mountain Tunnel connection.
Move a military unit from your territory through the tunnel so the move ends on an enemy-owned tile.

achievements.description: Have one of your Rock Band units perform a concert adjacent to a Maori Pa unique improvement
achievements.summary: Perform a Rock Concert on a tile beside a Māori Pā.

steps.text: In Hot Seat, play Māori and another civilization. Use a Māori Toa to build a Pā, then place a Theater Square beside the Pā.
As the other civilization, research Cold War and buy a Rock Band with Faith. Name the band and perform at the Theater Square beside the Pā.

achievements.description: Have Stonehenge become submerged due to Coastal Flooding
achievements.summary: Allow coastal sea-level rise to submerge Stonehenge.

steps.text: Begin in the Ancient or Classical Era. Build Stonehenge on a coastal lowland tile beside Stone. Choose a tile marked as low enough to flood.
Develop Coal- and Oil-consuming industry and units to raise emissions. Leave Stonehenge exposed to rising seas.
Wait until the Stonehenge tile is permanently underwater. Initial flooding alone does not count.

achievements.description: Have no cities following your religion then convert a city to your religion using a Rock Band unit
achievements.summary: Restore your religion with a Rock Band after no city in the world follows that religion.

steps.text: Set up two human-controlled civilizations in Hot Seat. Found your religion as Player 1 and a different religion as Player 2.
As Player 1, research Cold War and buy a Rock Band with Faith. Name the band and give it Religious Rock; the Hallyu policy from Cultural Hegemony lets you choose its promotion.
Use Player 2’s Missionaries to convert every city following Player 1’s religion, including foreign cities and city-states.
Perform a concert with the Religious Rock band to convert the host city back to your religion.

achievements.description: Achieve first place in all three Nobel Prizes in the same game
achievements.summary: Take first place in the Nobel Peace, Literature and Physics competitions in one match.

steps.text: Include Sweden in the match. From the Industrial Era onward, support World Congress proposals that open the Nobel competitions.
Build the output and Great People recruitment needed by each competition. Finish first in Peace, Literature and Physics during the same match.

achievements.description: Win a Diplomatic Victory Resolution and use it to reduce another player's progress toward that victory
achievements.summary: Pass a Diplomatic Victory resolution that removes another leader’s victory progress.

steps.text: In World Congress, select the Diplomatic Victory outcome that takes points away and choose another leader as its target.
Commit enough Diplomatic Favor to make that outcome and target win the vote.

achievements.description: As Wilfrid Laurier, successfully complete an Emergency
achievements.summary: Win an Emergency while playing as Wilfrid Laurier.

steps.text: Choose Wilfrid Laurier on a large map with several civilizations. Watch World Congress for an Emergency you can join.
Join the Emergency and meet its objective before its deadline.

achievements.description: As Hungary, have Christianity as your dominant religion and defeat a unit whose Civilization's dominant religion is not Christianity
achievements.summary: As Hungary with a Christian majority religion, destroy a unit from a civilization without a Christian majority.

steps.text: As Hungary, make Catholicism, Protestantism or Eastern Orthodoxy your dominant religion. In Hot Seat, make a non-Christian religion dominant in the opposing civilization.
Declare war and destroy an opposing military unit; a Catapult can finish a weakened Warrior.

achievements.description: As Pachacuti, construct a Terrace Farm that is adjacent to 2 Aqueducts and 4 Mountains
achievements.summary: As Pachacuti, place a Terrace Farm beside two Aqueducts and four mountains.

steps.text: Find a resource-free hill surrounded by four mountains and two non-mountain tiles. The mountains must leave enough room to settle two cities at legal distances.
Settle the two cities so each can put an Aqueduct on one of the two remaining tiles beside the hill. Build both Aqueducts.
Use a Builder to place the Terrace Farm on the central hill.

achievements.displayName: One does not simply walk into Ngauruhoe
achievements.description: As the Maori, have a Maori Toa discover the Ngauruhoe volcano
achievements.summary: Discover Ngauruhoe with a Māori Toa.

guide.context: Volcanoes receive their names when first discovered. If another unit discovers Ngauruhoe, start a new attempt.

steps.text: Play Māori on a large map with few opponents. Recruit Toa units and use them to uncover undiscovered volcanoes.
Keep exploring with Toa units until one discovers a volcano named Ngauruhoe.

achievements.description: As Mansa Musa, send a Trade Route to Mecca that gives the sending player at least 30 gold
achievements.summary: Earn at least 30 Gold from a Trade Route sent to Mecca while playing Mansa Musa.

steps.text: Include Arabia in your game as Mansa Musa and find its city of Mecca.
Develop an origin city with many flat Desert tiles and a Suguba. Use Gold bonuses such as E-commerce or Market Economy to raise the route yield.
Check the Trader’s route preview and start the route to Mecca once the sender receives at least 30 Gold.

achievements.description: As Dido, complete the Move Capital project on 4 different continents
achievements.summary: As Dido, complete Move Capital projects on four different continents.

steps.text: Use the Continents lens to locate four different continents. Settle coastal cities on them and build a Cothon in each destination city.
Finish the Move Capital project in a city on each of four different continents. Track the continents where you complete the project.

achievements.description: As the Ottomans, capture another Civilization's capital and then rename it
achievements.summary: As the Ottomans, capture another civilization’s capital and change the captured city’s name.

steps.text: Set up a Hot Seat match with the Ottomans and another civilization. Give both sides a second city and disable Domination Victory.
As the Ottomans, capture the opposing capital. Open its city details and rename the city.

achievements.description: As Kristina, at the start of a turn have cities in five different terrain types (Snow, Tundra, Desert, Plains and Grassland) and have Open Air Museums in all of them
achievements.summary: Begin a turn as Kristina with cities on all five land terrains and an Open-Air Museum in each.

steps.text: As Kristina, use an Information Era start and settle cities with City Centers on Snow, Tundra, Desert, Plains and Grassland.
Build an Open-Air Museum in each of those five cities, then advance to the next turn.

achievements.displayName: Meet the New Boss, Same as the Old Boss
achievements.description: As Eleanor, gain a city to loyalty that was owned by a different civilization with Eleanor as its leader
achievements.summary: As Eleanor of Aquitaine, gain a city through Loyalty from the other civilization led by Eleanor.

steps.text: Set up a Renaissance Era Hot Seat game with Eleanor leading England and Eleanor leading France. Set both players to Human.
Use the opposing player’s extra Settler to found a city near your capital where the settling preview shows heavy negative Loyalty.
Leave that city under Loyalty pressure until control passes to your Eleanor.

achievements.displayName: Let Our Powers Combine – Wait Heart is Missing!
achievements.description: Have a city with a Wind Farm, Solar Farm, Hydroelectric Dam, and Geothermal Plant
achievements.summary: Equip one city with a Geothermal Plant, Hydroelectric Dam, Solar Farm and Wind Farm.

steps.text: Use an Information Era start. Find a city site containing a Geothermal Fissure, hills, flat land and floodplains beside a river.
Build the Dam where the river touches at least two edges of the floodplain tile, then add its Hydroelectric Dam building.
Use Builders to add a Wind Farm on a hill, a Solar Farm on flat land and a Geothermal Plant on the fissure, all in that city.

achievements.description: Complete the Carbon Recapture project 10 times during a single game
achievements.summary: Finish ten Carbon Recapture projects within one match.

steps.text: Research Global Warming Mitigation and build Industrial Zones in cities that will run the project.
Complete Carbon Recapture ten times across your cities before ending the match.

achievements.description: Be the first to complete all the technologies in the Future Era in a game with 8 or more players
achievements.summary: Be the first civilization to complete the entire Future Era technology set in a match with at least eight players.

steps.text: Create a Gathering Storm match with eight or more civilization slots, including yourself; AI opponents count. Use Settler difficulty and an Information Era start.
Prioritize Science and complete the entire Future Era technology tree before any opponent does.

achievements.displayName: And the Walls Kept Tumbling Down
achievements.description: Have your Roman city lose 6 population from one Vesuvius eruption
achievements.summary: Lose six population from one Vesuvius eruption in a Roman city.

steps.text: Choose Rome on True Start Location Europe, set Disaster Intensity to 4 and settle beside Vesuvius.
Grow the nearby city with farms and food from clearing Woods or Rainforest. Keep Builders ready to repair eruption damage.
Keep growing and waiting for eruptions until a single eruption removes six population from that city.

achievements.description: Have a district be pillaged by 3 different random events
achievements.summary: Have the same district pillaged by three separate natural-disaster events.

steps.text: Set Disaster Intensity to 4 and build a district beside an active volcano or on vulnerable floodplains.
Repair that district after each disaster so later events can pillage it again. Continue until three events have damaged the same district.

achievements.description: Win the Black Death as England
achievements.summary: Win The Black Death scenario as England.

steps.text: Start The Black Death as England on Settler difficulty. Choose either the Science or Culture route.
Build Campuses for Science or Theater Squares for Culture. Buy their buildings and use pillaging to support your economy.
Complete Invention or The Middle Class before the scenario’s 85-turn limit.

achievements.description: Win the Black Death as France
achievements.summary: Win The Black Death scenario as France.

steps.text: Start The Black Death as France on Settler difficulty. Choose either the Science or Culture route.
Build Campuses for Science or Theater Squares for Culture. Buy their buildings and use pillaging to support your economy.
Complete Invention or The Middle Class before the scenario’s 85-turn limit.

achievements.description: Win the Black Death as Castile
achievements.summary: Win The Black Death scenario as Castile.

steps.text: Start The Black Death as Castile on Settler difficulty. Choose either the Science or Culture route.
Build Campuses for Science or Theater Squares for Culture. Buy their buildings and use pillaging to support your economy.
Complete Invention or The Middle Class before the scenario’s 85-turn limit.

achievements.description: Win the Black Death as the Holy Roman Empire
achievements.summary: Win The Black Death scenario as the Holy Roman Empire.

steps.text: Select the Holy Roman Empire and Settler difficulty for The Black Death. Choose either the Science or Culture route.
Build Campuses for Science or Theater Squares for Culture. Buy their buildings and use pillaging to support your economy.
Complete Invention or The Middle Class before the scenario’s 85-turn limit.

achievements.description: Win the Black Death after turn 80
achievements.summary: Win The Black Death scenario after turn 80.

steps.text: Play The Black Death on Settler and develop enough Science or Culture to approach the final technology or civic.
Save before completing Invention or The Middle Class. Hold back the final research until turn 81 or later, then finish before the 85-turn scenario ends.

achievements.description: Win the Black Death after conquering five cities
achievements.summary: Win The Black Death scenario after capturing five cities.

steps.text: Play The Black Death on Settler as the Holy Roman Empire. Use Teutonic Knights to attack nearby city-states.
Capture five cities before finishing Invention or The Middle Class to win the scenario.

achievements.description: Train 25 Plague Doctors during the Black Death scenario
achievements.summary: Train 25 Plague Doctors in The Black Death scenario.

steps.text: In The Black Death, assign cities to train Plague Doctors as soon as they become available. Keep producing them until 25 have been trained.

achievements.description: Win War Machine as France
achievements.summary: Win War Machine while playing France.

steps.text: Create a local Hot Seat War Machine match and control both France and Germany.
As France, keep Paris. Skip Germany’s turns without attacking and finish all 40 turns.

achievements.description: Win War Machine as Germany
achievements.summary: Win War Machine while playing Germany.

steps.text: Create a local Hot Seat War Machine match as Germany with France controlled by a second human slot.
Move your Artillery and Infantry through the central route toward Paris. As France, leave the route undefended.
Bombard and capture Paris before the 40-turn limit.

achievements.description: Win War Machine without training any units
achievements.summary: Win War Machine without training a single unit.

steps.text: Play France in a local Hot Seat War Machine match and leave Germany idle.
Use only your starting army and keep Paris for all 40 turns. Never produce a unit; use Shift+Enter to end turns when city production has no useful choice.

achievements.description: As Germany, win War Machine within 25 turns
achievements.summary: As Germany, win War Machine in no more than 25 turns.

steps.text: Control both sides in local Hot Seat. On France’s first turn, disband its units.
Move Germany’s starting army and Artillery through the central route to Paris, taking Verdun on the way.
Capture Paris by turn 25.

achievements.description: In War Machine, as France, conquer Metz within 5 turns
achievements.summary: As France, capture Metz by turn five in War Machine.

steps.text: Start a local Hot Seat War Machine match, controlling both France and Germany. Leave Metz undefended as Germany.
Move France’s Artillery corps and Infantry corps to Metz. Bombard the city and capture it by turn five.

achievements.description: In War Machine, reduce and capture a full-health city in a single turn
achievements.summary: In War Machine, capture a city from full health within one turn.

steps.text: In local Hot Seat War Machine, use France’s Artillery corps and Infantry corps against an undefended Metz.
Leave the city at full health until both units are ready. Bombard it and capture it with Infantry during the same turn.

achievements.description: Win the Black Death scenario on Deity difficulty
achievements.summary: On Deity difficulty, achieve victory in The Black Death scenario.

steps.text: Choose Deity in The Black Death and commit early to Culture. Build and improve Theater Squares.
Use several Caravels to pillage enemy coasts for Gold, Faith and Culture. Add mounted land raiders where useful.
Spend pillaging income on Theater Square buildings. Use Plague Doctors and Flagellants to hold Loyalty through plague waves.
Finish The Middle Class before turn 85.

achievements.description: Perform a Rock Concert in Cleveland
achievements.summary: Perform a Rock Concert in the city of Cleveland.

steps.text: In local Hot Seat, include America and another civilization. As America, found cities until Cleveland appears and give Cleveland a Theater Square.
As the other civilization, unlock Rock Bands with Cold War, buy one with Faith and name it. Perform its concert at Cleveland’s Theater Square.

achievements.description: Win the Red Death scenario
achievements.summary: Win a Red Death match.

steps.text: Choose Red Death through Multiplayer. Use a local Hot Seat game or a private match with AI opponents on Settler.
Protect your Civilian and keep your units inside the shrinking safe area. Eliminate the other factions and be the last surviving faction.

achievements.description: Nuclear Strike another faction in the Red Death scenario
achievements.summary: Strike another faction with a nuclear weapon in Red Death.

steps.text: Choose the Jocks faction in Red Death to begin with a nuclear weapon, or obtain a Thermonuclear Device from a Supply Drop.
Locate another faction’s units and launch the nuclear strike onto their position.

achievements.description: Get nuked by another faction in the Red Death scenario
achievements.summary: Have another faction hit your units with a nuclear strike in Red Death.

steps.text: Set up a local Hot Seat Red Death match controlling two factions. As one faction, acquire a Thermonuclear Device from a Supply Drop.
Move the other faction’s units into the strike area, then launch the weapon onto those units.

achievements.description: Claim a Supply Drop in the Red Death scenario
achievements.summary: Collect a Supply Drop in Red Death.

steps.text: Wait until the Red Death boundary begins advancing. Find a blue parachute marker near the edge of the safe area and move a unit onto that tile.

achievements.description: Lose your last Civilian within the first ten turns in the Red Death scenario
achievements.summary: Lose your final Civilian in Red Death during the first ten turns.

steps.text: Begin a Red Death match and immediately delete your starting Civilian before turn ten.

achievements.description: Win a regular game as Lady Six Sky.
achievements.summary: Win a normal match while leading as Lady Six Sky.

steps.text: Select @npc{Lady Six Sky} in Advanced Setup. Set Settler difficulty, a late starting era, and a custom limit of 3–5 turns. Keep only Score Victory enabled.
Found cities with your starting Settlers and improve your score before the final turn. Finish the match with the highest score.

achievements.description: Win a regular game as Simón Bolívar.
achievements.summary: Win a normal match while leading as Simón Bolívar.

steps.text: Select @npc{Simón Bolívar} in Advanced Setup. Set Settler difficulty, a late starting era, and a custom limit of 3–5 turns. Keep only Score Victory enabled.
Found cities with your starting Settlers and improve your score before the final turn. Finish the match with the highest score.

achievements.description: As the Maya found a settlement adjacent to 4 luxury resources.
achievements.summary: Found a Maya city on a tile next to four luxury resources.

steps.text: Play Lady Six Sky with Abundant resources. Find a tile touching four luxury-resource tiles and settle directly on that tile; use WorldBuilder to arrange the four resources if needed.

achievements.description: As Simón Bolívar activate all the Comandante Generals across multiple games.
achievements.summary: Activate the retirement abilities of all ten Comandante Generals as Simón Bolívar across any number of games.

guide.context: Play Simón Bolívar to receive a random Comandante General when a new era begins. For faster attempts, select Standard Rules and start new games in an era later than Medieval and retire the starting General. Retirement requirements appear when you hover over Retire. Progress carries between games.

achievements.description: Win any Victory with Apocalypse mode enabled.
achievements.summary: Achieve a victory with Apocalypse mode switched on.

steps.text: Select Gathering Storm rules and enable Apocalypse in game setup. Win on Settler difficulty before climate change reaches its final phase.

achievements.displayName: The end of the world as we know it
achievements.description: Be the last person standing after comets begin falling.
achievements.summary: Remain the only civilization after the Apocalypse comets start falling.

steps.text: Select Gathering Storm rules and enable Apocalypse with one opponent, no city-states, and only Domination Victory. Expand across the map and conquer every enemy city except the final capital.
Use Coal Power Plants and remove forests and rainforests to accelerate warming. After comets begin, wait until a comet destroys the last enemy city.

achievements.description: Use a max-promotions Soothsayer to sacrifice a max-promotions GDR.
achievements.summary: Sacrifice a fully upgraded Giant Death Robot with a Soothsayer holding all five promotions.

guide.context: Avoid Coal, Oil and Uranium extraction while developing the Soothsayer so climate change does not end the preparation window.

steps.text: Enable Apocalypse with Gathering Storm rules. Build Faith income and recruit a Soothsayer before the Appease the Gods competitions.

Earn at least Silver in five Appease the Gods competitions to promote the Soothsayer five times. Sacrifice land military units with melee strength beside an active volcano during each competition. Naval units and units without melee strength do not count.
Research the four Future Era technologies that upgrade Giant Death Robots. Bring the fully upgraded robot and Soothsayer beside an active volcano during another competition, then sacrifice the robot.

achievements.description: Wanderers - Explore 30 city ruins across multiple games.
achievements.summary: Explore thirty city ruins as the Wanderers across any number of Red Death matches.

steps.text: Choose Wanderers on a Huge map in Red Death. Move units into city ruins until your cumulative total reaches thirty.

achievements.description: Preppers - Have 5 units earn 5 promotions across multiple games.
achievements.summary: Promote five Preppers units to their fifth promotion across any number of Red Death matches.

steps.text: Play Doomsday Preppers on a Huge Red Death map. Earn experience from ruins and combat, then give five units five promotions each. A Machine Gun near a Barbarian spawn provides a repeatable experience target.

achievements.description: Mad Scientists - Heal 1000 health points across multiple games.
achievements.summary: Restore a total of 1,000 health to Mad Scientists units across Red Death matches.

steps.text: Play Mad Scientists in Red Death. Fight to damage your units, then heal the survivors; accumulate 1,000 restored health across matches.

achievements.description: Be defeated 5 times in the Red Death scenario.
achievements.summary: Lose five Red Death matches.

steps.text: Start Red Death and allow your last Civilian to die. Finish five matches this way; Cultists can sacrifice their starting Civilian to the Undying Eye.

achievements.description: Mutants - Attack a unit outside the Red Death while inside the Red Death 20 times.
achievements.summary: As Mutants, make twenty attacks from irradiated tiles against units outside the radiation in Red Death.

steps.text: Choose Mutants in Red Death. Stand in the Red Death or purple radiation spread by your faction, then attack units on clean tiles. Accumulate twenty such attacks.

achievements.description: Pirates - Spend 50 turns in the water across multiple games.
achievements.summary: Spend fifty turns in water as Pirates across Red Death matches.

steps.text: Play the Pirates faction in Red Death. Embark your units and leave them in water, returning to land to heal when necessary. Accumulate fifty water turns across matches.

achievements.description: Borderlords - Trick enemy factions into triggering Grieving Gifts 5 times across multiple games.
achievements.summary: Have enemy factions trigger five Borderlords Grieving Gifts across Red Death matches.

steps.text: Play Borderlords in a private Red Death game against AI. Place Grieving Gifts near the shrinking safe-zone boundary where enemies seek Supply Drops. Wait for enemies to collect five gifts.

achievements.description: Cultists - Kill 10 units with the Undying Eye.
achievements.summary: Destroy ten units with the Cultists’ Undying Eye in Red Death.

steps.text: Choose Cultists in Red Death. Use your starting Undying Eye to deliver killing attacks against ten units; hunt around Barbarian spawn areas.
The Undying Eye starts damaged and cannot heal normally. Sacrifice friendly units to heal it, and keep it safe from retaliation.

achievements.description: Jocks - Use Hail Marys to wound, but not kill, 5 Civilians across multiple games.
achievements.summary: Wound five Civilians with Jocks Hail Mary attacks without killing those Civilians across Red Death matches.

steps.text: Choose Jocks in Red Death. Use Hail Mary against a healthy Civilian, then wait for the ability to recharge. Your own Civilians count; keep them alive for five nonlethal hits.

achievements.displayName: They're coming to get you, Barbara
achievements.description: Zombie Beastmasters - Spawn 30 Zombie Hordes through combat kills.
achievements.summary: Create thirty Zombie Hordes through Zombie Beastmasters combat kills in Red Death.

steps.text: Play Zombie Beastmasters in Red Death. Keep delivering combat kills until your faction ability has produced thirty Zombie Hordes.

achievements.displayName: Out of Sight, Out of Mind
achievements.description: Aliens - Attack while cloaked 20 times.
achievements.summary: Make twenty attacks while cloaked as Aliens in Red Death.

steps.text: Play Aliens in Red Death. Activate Xenological Camouflage before attacking. Wait for the cooldown and cloak again before each later attack until twenty attacks count.

achievements.description: Win a regular game as Menelik II.
achievements.summary: Win a normal match while leading as Menelik II.

steps.text: Select @npc{Menelik II} in Advanced Setup. Set Settler difficulty, a late starting era, and a custom limit of 3–5 turns. Keep only Score Victory enabled.
Found cities with your starting Settlers and improve your score before the final turn. Finish the match with the highest score.

achievements.description: Defeat an Infantry unit whose capital is on another continent with an Oromo Cavalry.
achievements.summary: Destroy an Infantry unit with Oromo Cavalry when the Infantry owner’s capital is on a different continent from yours.

steps.text: Set up a Hot Seat match with Menelik II as player one and capitals on separate continents.
Research Castles and keep an Oromo Cavalry. Have the other player research Replaceable Parts and train Infantry.
Weaken the Infantry with stronger units, then deliver the killing attack with the Oromo Cavalry.

achievements.description: Earn all Governor promotions for the Owls of Minerva Secret Society.
achievements.summary: Unlock every Governor promotion in the Owls of Minerva Secret Society.

steps.text: Select Rise and Fall or Gathering Storm rules and enable Secret Societies, then send Envoys to city-states until the Owls of Minerva invitation appears. Join that society before joining any other.
Spend Governor Titles on the Owls of Minerva Governor until every promotion is unlocked. A late-era start makes the titles and promotion tiers available sooner.

achievements.description: Win a regular game as Basil II.
achievements.summary: Win a normal match while leading as Basil II.

steps.text: Select @npc{Basil II} in Advanced Setup. Set Settler difficulty, a late starting era, and a custom limit of 3–5 turns. Keep only Score Victory enabled.
Found cities with your starting Settlers and improve your score before the final turn. Finish the match with the highest score.

achievements.displayName: Rome is Where the Heart is
achievements.description: As Byzantium, take the original capital of Rome while it is following your founded religion.
achievements.summary: Capture Rome’s original capital as Basil II while the city follows a religion you founded.

steps.text: Start a match as Basil II against Rome, no later than the Renaissance Era so you can found a religion.
Found a religion, convert Rome’s original capital to it, then conquer that capital.

achievements.description: As Gaul, kill a Tank with a Gaesatae.
achievements.summary: Destroy a Tank with a Gaesatae while playing Gaul.

steps.text: Start as Ambiorix in an early era and retain a Gaesatae without upgrading the unit.
Wait for an opponent to build a Tank. Damage the Tank with stronger units, then finish the Tank with the Gaesatae; Hot Seat lets you control the target.

achievements.description: In Dramatic Ages Mode, lose 4 or more cities by entering a Dark Age.
achievements.summary: Lose at least four cities when a Dark Age begins in Dramatic Ages mode.

steps.text: Select Rise and Fall or Gathering Storm rules and enable Dramatic Ages. Establish at least five cities, with outlying settlements away from your capital.
Keep Era Score below the Golden Age requirement. Enter a Dark Age and lose at least four cities to rebellion.

achievements.description: In Dramatic Ages Mode, enter a Golden Age with an excess 20 Era Score
achievements.summary: Enter a Golden Age in Dramatic Ages mode with at least 20 Era Score above the required threshold.

steps.text: Select Rise and Fall or Gathering Storm rules and enable Dramatic Ages and build Era Score until you exceed the next Golden Age threshold by at least 20. Maintain that surplus when the era changes.

achievements.description: In Dramatic Age Mode, as Georgia, have simultaneously a Golden and a Dark Policy active.
achievements.summary: Equip a Golden Age policy and a Dark Age policy together as Georgia in Dramatic Ages mode.

steps.text: With Rise and Fall installed for Georgia, select Rise and Fall or Gathering Storm rules. Play Tamar with Dramatic Ages enabled and reach a Golden Age.
Adopt a government unlocked by Political Philosophy. Use Georgia’s extra Wildcard slot to equip one Golden Age policy and one Dark Age policy at the same time.

achievements.description: Dread Pirate - Sink 10 ships while using Walk the Plank across multiple games.
achievements.summary: Sink ten ships with Walk the Plank active as Dread Pirates across Pirates matches.

steps.text: Choose Dread Pirates in the Pirates scenario. Activate Walk the Plank before finishing weakened ships. Accumulate ten sinkings while the ability is active.

achievements.description: Privateer - Ensure that your patron has a naval fleet twice the size of any other colonial power.
achievements.summary: Give your Privateers patron a fleet at least twice as large as every other colonial power’s fleet.

steps.text: Choose Privateers in the Pirates scenario. Use Bring Her Home to transfer badly damaged colonial ships to your patron. Keep capturing rivals’ ships until your patron has at least double each rival’s fleet.

achievements.description: Swashbuckler - Visit the tavern of 10 ports in a single game.
achievements.summary: Visit taverns in ten different ports during one Pirates match as Swashbucklers.

steps.text: Choose Swashbucklers in Pirates. Sail beside a port and use Visit Tavern, then move to another port. Visit ten different ports within the 60-turn match.

achievements.displayName: Love It When a Plan Comes Together
achievements.description: Hoarder - Sink or capture a treasure ship while a treasure escort is locked by a chainshot.
achievements.summary: Sink or capture a Treasure Ship as Hoarders while Chain Shot immobilizes one of its escorts.

steps.text: Choose Hoarders in Pirates and locate a Treasure Ship with its escort. Bring several ships so you can finish the target quickly.
Use Chain Shot on one escort ship, then sink or capture the Treasure Ship before that escort recovers.

achievements.description: Win the Pirates scenario.
achievements.summary: Finish the Pirates scenario with the highest score.

steps.text: Create a private Pirates match against AI on Settler difficulty. Earn points from combat, treasure and infamous deeds, then lead the total score when the 60-turn scenario finishes.

achievements.description: Lose the Pirates scenario due to mutiny.
achievements.summary: Lose a Pirates match when your fleet mutinies.

steps.text: Start Pirates and leave your ship idle until upkeep empties your Gold reserve. Reach zero Gold to trigger mutiny and lose the scenario.

achievements.description: Sink or capture a treasure ship.
achievements.summary: Capture or sink a Treasure Ship in the Pirates scenario.

steps.text: Watch for the Treasure Ship notification in Pirates and follow its highlighted route. Weaken the Treasure Ship, then sink or capture the vessel.

achievements.description: Win the Pirates scenario using mostly Treasure Points.
achievements.summary: Win Pirates with Treasure Points as your largest score category.

steps.text: Choose Hoarders on Settler difficulty. Bury treasure chests, plunder coastal targets and sink Treasure Ships. Finish the 60-turn match in first place with Treasure Points higher than your other score categories.

achievements.displayName: I am Kind of a Big Deal
achievements.description: Win the Pirates scenario using mostly Infamous Pirate Points.
achievements.summary: Win Pirates with Infamous Pirate Points as your largest score category.

steps.text: Choose Swashbucklers on Settler difficulty. Board ships, sack ports and sink Infamous Pirates. Finish the 60-turn match in first place with Infamous Pirate Points higher than your other score categories.

achievements.displayName: I Want You to Hit Me as Hard as You Can
achievements.description: Win the Pirates scenario using mostly Fightin' Points.
achievements.summary: Win Pirates with Fightin’ Points as your largest score category.

steps.text: Choose Dread Pirates on Settler difficulty. Focus on sinking and capturing enemy ships, promoting your fleet as it gains experience. Finish the 60-turn match in first place with Fightin’ Points higher than your other score categories.

achievements.displayName: Let's Do the Time Warp Again
achievements.description: As Babylon, earn 5 tech boosts for techs that are at least one era later than your current era.
achievements.summary: Trigger five Eurekas for technologies at least one era ahead of Babylon’s current era in one match.

steps.text: Play Hammurabi and inspect the technology tree for later-era Eurekas. Complete five of those requirements while each target technology is at least one era ahead of your current era.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy Hero with your Hero.
achievements.summary: Destroy an enemy Hero with a Hero you control.

steps.text: Enable Heroes & Legends and claim a Hero through a Monument city. Weaken an enemy Hero with your army, then make your Hero deliver the killing attack; Hot Seat allows you to control both sides.

achievements.description: Recall a Hero 5 times in a single game.
achievements.summary: Recall the same Hero five times during one match.

guide.context: A Hero has one recall available per era. Later recalls cost more Faith.

steps.text: Claim a Hero early in an Ancient Era Heroes & Legends game and build a strong Faith income.
After that Hero dies or expires, purchase the Hero with Faith in the original city. Recall the same Hero in five different later eras.

achievements.description: Recall a Hero after the Industrial Era.
achievements.summary: Recall a Hero in an era later than the Industrial Era.

steps.text: After a claimed Hero dies or expires, wait until the Modern Era or later. Spend Faith to recall the Hero in the city where that Hero was first claimed.

achievements.description: Claim 5 Heroes in a single game.
achievements.summary: Claim five different Heroes in one match.

steps.text: Enable Heroes & Legends. Build five cities with Monuments, discover Heroes through exploration or Heroic Tales projects, then complete a different Hero’s Devotion project in each city.

achievements.description: Control a 100% Monopoly on a given Luxury Resource on a Standard sized map or larger.
achievements.summary: Control every copy of one luxury resource on a Standard or larger map with Monopolies and Corporations enabled.

steps.text: Enable Monopolies and Corporations on a Standard or larger map. Research Mercantilism to view global resource totals, then acquire and improve every tile of one luxury type.

achievements.displayName: Jack of all Trades, Master of None
achievements.description: Win a game on a Standard sized map or larger with 5 or more Industries, but no Corporations.
achievements.summary: Win on a Standard or larger map while owning at least five Industries and no Corporations.

steps.text: Enable Monopolies and Corporations on a Standard or larger map. Research Currency and establish at least five cities.
For each Industry, control two improved copies of the same luxury resource and use a Builder to create the Industry. Build one Industry in each of five cities.
Win the match while retaining all five Industries. Do not upgrade any Industry to a Corporation.

achievements.description: Control 5 Luxury Resource Monopolies at once on a Standard sized map or larger.
achievements.summary: Hold monopolies on five different luxury resources simultaneously on a Standard or larger map.

steps.text: Enable Monopolies and Corporations on a Standard or larger map. Expand to acquire and improve at least 60% of the world’s tiles for each of five luxury types. Use the Global Resource Report to track the monopolies.

achievements.description: Hire a unique unit from a Barbarian Clan.
achievements.summary: Purchase a civilization’s unique unit from a Barbarian Clan.

steps.text: Enable Barbarian Clans. Inspect an outpost’s Hire option and buy a unique unit when the clan offers one.

achievements.description: Ransom 5 units from Barbarian Clans in a single game.
achievements.summary: Pay Barbarian Clans to return five captured units in one match.

steps.text: Enable Barbarian Clans. Let a clan capture a civilian, then pay its ransom. Arrange five ransom purchases in the same match; the same civilian and clan can be used again.

achievements.description: Hire, Bribe, Incite, and Raid the same Barbarian Clan.
achievements.summary: Use Hire, Bribe, Incite and Raid on one Barbarian Clan.

steps.text: Enable Barbarian Clans and save enough Gold for Hire, Bribe and Incite. Find a clan that another civilization has also encountered so Incite becomes available.
Use Hire, Bribe and Incite on that clan, then move a military unit into its outpost and choose Raid. Protect the outpost from destruction and raid before it becomes a city-state.

achievements.description: As Portugal, have a Trading Post in cities belonging to Brazil, India, and Japan.
achievements.summary: Establish Portuguese Trading Posts in at least one city each of Brazil, India and Japan.

steps.text: Choose João III and include Brazil, India and Japan as opponents on a water map.
Send Traders to accessible coastal cities belonging to each of those civilizations. Let each route finish so its destination receives your Trading Post.

achievements.description: Control at least 20 Zombie units at the start of your turn.
achievements.summary: Begin a turn controlling at least twenty Zombie units.

steps.text: With Babylon Pack installed for Heroes & Legends, enable Zombie Defense and Heroes & Legends, then claim Hunahpu and Xbalanque.
Kill Zombies with the twins to turn those Zombies into permanent units under your control. Recall the twins with Faith as needed, and retain twenty Zombies until your next turn starts.

achievements.description: Destroy a Zombie unit that has +50 or more Mutation Strength.
achievements.summary: Destroy a Zombie with at least +50 Mutation Strength.

steps.text: Enable Zombie Defense. Keep killing Zombies to increase their shared Mutation Strength. Inspect the combat tooltip and destroy a Zombie once its Mutation Strength bonus is at least +50.

achievements.description: Deal 50 or more damage to a single unit from trap damage on a single tile in one turn.
achievements.summary: Inflict at least fifty trap damage on one unit on one tile during a single turn.

steps.text: Enable Zombie Defense. Place an Advanced Trap so its tile also receives damage from two adjacent Reinforced Barricades.
Have an enemy unit enter the trapped tile. The Advanced Trap deals 20 damage and the two Reinforced Barricades add 15 each, totaling 50; Hot Seat allows you to move the target yourself.
